title: 36 Hours in Pittsburgh
abstract: Great restaurants, excellent shopping, breakthrough galleries and prestigious museums make this city of 89 distinct neighborhoods a hip destination.

title: 36 Hours in Dublin
abstract: Asian herbal shops and Polish galleries now share the history-soaked streets with old pubs and 18th-century town houses in the Irish capital.

title: 36 Hours in Toulouse
abstract: Under the city’s medieval church spires, a spider web of cobblestone lanes brims with art museums, theaters, upstart fashion boutiques and all-hours night life.

title: 36 Hours in Palermo
abstract: After decades of postwar neglect, the Sicilian capital is poised for a comeback. Crumbling roads are being repaved, landmarks scrubbed clean and a newfound pride can be felt.
